name: storybloq
description: Project memory for Claude Code and Codex. Storybloq stores tickets, issues, handovers, and lessons in a .story/ folder inside your repo.

roster.title: Seat roster Mod (experimental)
roster.description: Maintain .story/telemetry/roster/ from this session's agent events. Loads only when Claude Code runs with CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1 (T-507).

sidebar.title: Ledger sidebar Mod (experimental)
sidebar.description: Draw the .story/ ledger in a pane beside the transcript. Loads only when Claude Code runs with CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1 (T-508).

metadata.functionHooks: Early-access Claude Code API (client 2.1.273, see hooks/client-api.ts). Both Mods are off until their userConfig option is set; no product decision on shipping them is implied by their presence here (T-505).
